skill.name: linkedin-personas
skill.description: Builds 2 to 4 persona cards with the user and puts each lead in one. Use before writing to a new list, or when messages sound generic or repeat the job title.
skill.summary: Create evidence-based LinkedIn persona cards, classify leads, and refine messaging inputs using confirmed replies.
skill.author: bereach-ai

security_audit.summary: All 42 static findings are false positives involving Markdown formatting, business prose, fictional persona examples, or bibliography entries. No evidence found of shell execution, weak cryptography, system reconnaissance, credential theft, or audit-directed prompt injection. One semantic finding identifies blanket provenance suppression, which can prevent users from checking data permissions before outreach.

remediation.issue: Blanket instructions hide data origins and discovery methods from user-facing pages.
remediation.suggestion: Replace the provenance-hiding rules with concise source labels and an accessible source history, while keeping confidential details out of prospect messages.

semantic_findings.title: Data Provenance Hidden From Users
semantic_findings.description: SKILL.md forbids saying 'where the data comes from or how people were found'; artifact rules also hide provenance from user-facing pages. This can conceal unexpected CRM or document use and prevent users from checking data permissions before outreach.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Both passages explicitly prohibit disclosing data origins, including on user-facing pages. Other source-labeling rules limit certainty about enforcement, but do not remove this blanket prohibition.

content.user_title: Build LinkedIn Personas and Classify Leads
content.value_statement: Generic outreach often treats job titles as complete buyer profiles. This skill builds evidence-based persona cards and classifies leads by company fit, role, and buying situation.
actual_capabilities: Draft two to four persona cards covering titles, buying timing, pain, real offers, proof, objections, and tone.
Use supplied business material and connected sources to prefill cards, while marking unsupported statements as guesses.
Classify leads into one persona, hold ambiguous matches for review, and identify out-of-scope contacts.
Save persona cards to Bereach offering memory and add persona tags to contacts when the required tools are available.
Provide persona fields for a companion messaging skill to create distinct outreach templates.
Propose persona revisions from repeated reply evidence and update tags after approved renames or merges.
limitations: Bereach memory, contact tagging, inbox access, and optional fit scoring require the corresponding connected tools; these integrations are not bundled.
Complete outreach pages, message creation, search planning, and results reporting depend on companion skills.
The skill cannot validate invented offers, customer claims, or missing facts; provisional assumptions require user confirmation or reply evidence.
Source-hiding instructions create a transparency risk; require source visibility and review data permissions before using connected records.

use_cases.title: Prepare a First Prospect List
use_cases.description: Turn actual customer experience into two to four provisional personas before a founder starts outreach.

use_cases.title: Resolve Ambiguous Lead Matches
use_cases.description: Classify contacts by company fit and role, then review uncertain matches before applying persona tags.

use_cases.title: Refine Personas From Replies
use_cases.description: Compare repeated buyer objections and timing signals, then propose evidence-backed changes for the next messaging test.

prompt_templates.title: Draft My First Personas
prompt_templates.prompt: Build two provisional LinkedIn persona cards from this business description and these three customer examples: [details]. Mark assumptions and ask only for missing essentials.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: create initial cards without connected tools.

prompt_templates.title: Review Existing Persona Evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these persona cards against my actual offers, customer proof, and objection answers: [materials]. Flag unsupported claims, keep missing answers empty, and show sources.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: improve existing cards before outreach.

prompt_templates.title: Classify a Lead Batch
prompt_templates.prompt: Classify these leads using these approved cards and company criteria: [data]. Explain each match and hold ambiguous rows. Preview tags without writing contact updates.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: review classification before changing connected records.

prompt_templates.title: Propose Evidence-Based Revisions
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these dated replies and invitation counts by persona: [results]. Require two matching replies and ten invitations before confirming changes. Show changed lines and sources. Queue approved changes for the next test; do not edit live messages.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: revise personas after a measured outreach cycle.

output_examples.input: A fictional calibration software seller provides one real offer and an unnamed customer case, but no objection answer.
output: Persona: Network manager at a water utility with ageing meters.
Found by: Network Manager, Head of Water Networks, Distribution Manager.
Why now: A meter renewal tender within six months; public signal: a published tender (guess).
Pain: Meter drift becomes visible only at the annual audit (guess).
Offer: A drift check on one district, as supplied by the seller.
Proof: Drift identified before an annual audit for an unnamed utility, in the seller's words.
Objection: Not now (guess). Answer: awaiting the seller's wording.

output_examples.input: Classify three supplied leads against approved network-manager and consultancy personas; one title is ambiguous and one lead is a student.
output: Sami L. | Network Manager | Network-manager persona | Sure: title matches one approved card.
Paul V. | Water Project Manager | To check: both cards fit; user decision required before tagging.
Lea R. | Student | No message: outside the approved audience.
Summary: one sure match, one unresolved match, and one held lead.

best_practices: Provide actual customer examples, existing offers, and your own objection answers; leave unsupported proof empty.
Require visible sources, confirm permission to use connected records, and approve named customer references before sharing them.
Review uncertain matches and proposed updates; confirm persona changes only after the required invitation counts and repeated reply evidence.
anti_patterns: Treating a job title as proof of a buyer's pain, timing, or willingness to purchase.
Inventing customer results, prices, offers, or objection answers to complete empty fields.
Using personal traits for classification or messaging leads whose persona match remains unresolved.

faq.question: What does the skill produce?
faq.answer: It produces two to four provisional persona cards, a lead classification view, and evidence-backed revisions after reviewing results.

faq.question: Can I use it without Bereach?
faq.answer: You can draft cards from supplied materials. Saving memory, tagging contacts, retrieving replies, and optional scoring require the corresponding Bereach tools.

faq.question: Does it send LinkedIn messages?
faq.answer: No direct sending workflow is defined here. It provides persona inputs to companion messaging and outreach skills.

faq.question: How are uncertain leads handled?
faq.answer: Ambiguous matches stay untagged and receive no message until the user decides. Out-of-scope leads are held; rejection requires approval.

faq.question: What evidence supports persona changes?
faq.answer: A confirmed change needs at least two replies expressing the same point and at least ten invitations. Changes name their sources.

faq.question: What should I check before connecting business data?
faq.answer: Confirm data permissions and request visible source labels. The skill contains provenance-hiding instructions, so review connected access and outputs carefully.
